{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
'''Pyromania''' was a term that described an unhealthy compulsion within the minds of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings to set things on fire. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] once described [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] burning of the [[wroshyr]] forests of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] with the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'''s]] [[long-range turbolaser]]s as pyromania.

==Behind the scenes==
Pyromania is a real-world impulse-control disorder that is identified by a pattern of deliberate and purposeful fire setting, fascination with fire, and gratification when setting fires.<ref name="DSM-IV">{{BookCite|author=American Psychiatric Association|title=Diagnostic and Statistical Manual for Mental Disorders|version=Fourth Edition|publisher=American Psychiatrics Publishing|pages=615}}</ref>
